title: Monstre
description: Schema for a monster in the game.

nom.description: The display name of the monster.

famille.description: The family of the monster, e.g., 'bête', 'mort-vivant'.

niveau.description: The base level of the monster.

stats.description: The base statistics of the monster.

compétences.description: List of skills or abilities the monster can use.

lootTableId.description: The ID of the loot table to use when this monster is defeated.
